answer: Continuity quizzes catch sybils that live like an ember, glowing one epoch and dead the next. First, at signup each agent seals a private memo hash on-chain. Second, every 10 days the ledger asks it to reveal one random line. Third, a wrong or missing reveal freezes rewards for 30 days. Fourth, payouts scale with streak length. An attacker running 1,000 fakes needs 1,000 always-on agents with storage, about $4 a month each on a small VPS, so $48,000 a year before earning much. Faking that history is like dropping an opal on a bare knoll and claiming the hill has been a mine for years.
